description: A Director of Employee Experience must decide whether to approve a six-week peer repair circle for a team experiencing recurring tension and finalize its facilitator, meeting time, participation rules, and confidentiality safeguards.

shared_context.S1: The product-operations team has experienced recurring tension during handoffs, and several team members have suggested trying a peer repair circle.
shared_context.S2: The proposed circle would meet once a week for a limited trial, with Helena responsible for approving the program and its operating terms.
shared_context.S3: Lee has been proposed as the circle's facilitator, and the draft plan lists Neutral Facilitator as the standard alternative if concerns arise about using Lee.
shared_context.S4: Before approving a new team-support program, Helena holds a standard team check-in to hear operational concerns and policy requirements and records the agreed terms.
shared_context.S5: Helena uses a round-robin record for this check-in: Darius, Mei, and Rafael must each submit one concise formal record item about their relevant concern or requirement, and Helena does not finalize the terms until all three recorded items have been accepted.

PF1.text: Darius directly observed Lee interrupting and dismissing colleagues in three recent repair discussions; he believes participants will not speak freely if Lee facilitates. He has not put these observations in a formal feedback record.

PF2.text: Mei has a standing caregiving commitment on Wednesday evenings and can attend reliably only on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00. She already told the program organizer this is the time she can sustain for the full trial.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed this week that People Operations policy requires participation to be opt-in, prohibits using circle disclosures in performance evaluations, and limits an initial trial to exactly six weeks. The draft plan was circulated before he completed that policy check.

acceptance_conditions: The peer repair circle must be approved with Neutral Facilitator rather than Lee.
The circle must meet on Tuesday from 16:00 to 17:00.
Circle disclosures must be protected from use in performance evaluations.
The initial trial must last exactly six weeks.
The settlement must include a documented commitment covering the three policy requirements.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'policy_compliance' or c['type'] == 'policy_update' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Darius's three direct observations change the facilitator choice from proposed Lee to the exact draft alternative Neutral Facilitator and provide the basis for approving the circle with that safeguard.
Mei's standing caregiving commitment changes the meeting schedule to exactly Tuesday 16:00-17:00 rather than an unspecified convenient weekly time.

Rafael's confirmed policy changes participation to opt-in, requires protected disclosures, fixes the initial pilot at exactly six weeks, and requires a documented policy commitment covering those requirements.
